title: SheetAlign: Grounded Interaction and Stage-Isolated Learning for Spreadsheet Agents
title_zh: SheetAlign：面向电子表格智能体的有据交互与阶段隔离学习
abstract_en: Spreadsheets are widely used for data analysis and supporting decision-making. Automating spreadsheet analysis while protecting sensitive data and controlling deployment costs motivates locally deployed open-weight large language models (LLMs). Meanwhile, complex spreadsheet tasks require both task reasoning and workbook understanding, while predefined operation interfaces impose additional tool-selection and invocation demands. We introduce SheetAlign, a spreadsheet manipulation framework with stage-isolated policy learning, organized around where to operate, what to change, and how to implement transformations. Task-guided inspection and API grounding anchor code generation in workbook observations and available operations, while stage-isolated learning optimizes program generation and review using edit-progress rewards. At inference, execution consistency selects programs through agreement among workbook states. On SpreadsheetBench, our grounded task interface improves Qwen3-4B's accuracy from 13.5% to 29.2% on average without training. With learning and execution consistency, SheetAlign achieves 32.8% accuracy on average on SpreadsheetBench and 30.1% on Domain-Spreadsheet, outperforming comparable baselines. The code will be made publicly available upon publication.
abstract_zh: 电子表格广泛用于数据分析与决策。为保护敏感数据并控制部署成本，研究者希望借助本地部署的开放权重大语言模型自动处理电子表格。然而，复杂任务不仅要求模型理解任务和工作簿，还要求它正确选择并调用预定义的操作接口。SheetAlign 将电子表格操作拆解为三个问题：在哪里操作、修改什么、如何实现修改。框架通过任务引导的工作簿检查与 API 对齐，使代码生成以实际观察到的表格内容和可用操作为依据；训练时采用阶段隔离的策略学习，以编辑进度为奖励优化程序生成与审查；推理时根据候选程序执行后所得工作簿状态的一致性选择程序。在无需训练的情况下，该任务接口将 Qwen3-4B 在 SpreadsheetBench 上的平均准确率从 13.5% 提升至 29.2%。加入策略学习和执行一致性筛选后，SheetAlign 在 SpreadsheetBench 和 Domain-Spreadsheet 上的平均准确率分别达到 32.8% 和 30.1%，优于可比基线。
key_points_zh: 将任务拆解为操作位置、修改内容和实现方式，并通过任务引导的工作簿检查与 API 对齐约束代码生成。
用编辑进度奖励分别优化程序生成与审查；推理时依据候选程序执行后的工作簿状态是否一致来筛选程序。
仅使用任务接口、不做训练，即可将 Qwen3-4B 在 SpreadsheetBench 上的平均准确率从 13.5% 提升至 29.2%，提高 15.7 个百分点。
完整的 SheetAlign 在 SpreadsheetBench 和 Domain-Spreadsheet 上分别达到 32.8% 和 30.1% 的平均准确率，优于可比基线。
